title: Beetroot and feta orzo
story: Beetroot colours a simple orzo dish, finished with feta and dill.
method: Cook orzo following the packet, reserving a mug of cooking water.
Warm oil in a saucepan and add beetroot with 2 tbsp water. Heat until piping hot, then add spinach and wilt.
Fold in orzo, lemon juice and half the feta. Loosen with cooking water if needed.
Divide between bowls and finish with remaining feta, dill and pepper.

title: Chocolate pots for two
story: Small chocolate cream pots that can be prepared before dinner.
method: Put chopped chocolate in a heatproof bowl. Heat cream and sugar in a small pan until steaming, without boiling hard.
Pour cream over the chocolate and stand for 2 minutes. Stir gently until smooth, then add vanilla.
Divide between two small heatproof glasses or ramekins. Cool briefly, cover and refrigerate for at least 2 hours until set.
Add raspberries just before serving. Keep chilled until required.
